deployments_detail.use: Cohere Health AI-powered prior authorization automation (diagnostic imaging); will publicly report PA metrics 2026

Strider: Humana's internal generative-AI writing/assistant tool used by employees for drafting, process documentation and communications, and referenced in the context of scaling enterprise recruiting.

Enterprise-approved generative-AI coding assistants used by Humana software engineers for code generation, code review and development, per Humana engineering job postings specifying GitHub Copilot and Claude Code as approved tools. [GitHub Copilot; Anthropic Claude Code]

Automated/AI-assisted prior authorization platform used across specialties (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, surgical, diagnostic imaging, sleep) to digitize care requests and enable real-time approvals for Humana Medicare Advantage members. [Cohere Health]

nH Predict AI model (via naviHealth) used to predict skilled-nursing/post-acute length of stay and inform coverage determinations for Medicare Advantage members. Deployed in production; now the subject of class-action litigation alleging improper denials. [naviHealth / nH Predict (UnitedHealth-owned)]

Advanced predictive models built on Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare / Azure to proactively identify members at high risk (e.g., hospital readmission and disease risk) for earlier clinical intervention, as part of the Humana-Microsoft strategic partnership. [Microsoft (Azure, Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare)]

Population Health Analytics Suite: in-house suite of data, reporting and machine-learning products for population health analysis, including models that incorporate social determinants of health (SDOH) data to identify at-risk members and gaps in care.

Agent Assist: agentic AI that summarizes call conversations in real time, anticipates member needs, and surfaces relevant benefit/eligibility info to member advocates in Humana's call centers. Built on Humana's agentic AI platform; began use in Oct 2025 with full rollout across member service centers in 2026. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini, Gemini Enterprise for CX)]

Provider Services Conversational Voice Agent with Watson: a conversational virtual assistant that lets provider administrative staff access pre-service, eligibility, benefits, claims, referral and cost information via natural-language voice, reducing costly pre-service phone calls. [IBM Watson (IBM Data and AI Expert Labs)]

Cogito real-time voice/behavioral AI deployed at the Humana Pharmacy call center to coach agents on empathy and communication during live calls, providing in-call guidance and a real-time customer-experience measure. [Cogito (now part of Verint)]
